description: Per company: the working day, and how extra hours are banked as time off.

fields.description: Used to turn hours of extra work into days of time off.
fields.label: Normal Working Day (Hours)

fields.description: Staff can bank extra hours as time off. Staff in the grades below claim time off for extra hours worked, and their leave approver approves it.
fields.label: Time Off in Lieu

fields.description: The leave type the time off is added to. Staff take the time off by applying for this leave as usual. Use a type kept for time off in lieu.
fields.label: Leave Type

fields.description: Staff in these grades earn time off; everyone else stays on paid overtime. Leave it empty and nobody can claim.
fields.label: Eligible Grades

fields.description: When extra work is agreed. "Authorise first": staff ask before the work, the approver agrees, and afterwards they confirm the hours actually worked.
fields.label: Authorisation
fields.options:
Claim afterwards
Authorise first, then confirm the hours

fields.description: Each hour after a normal working day counts as this many hours of time off. Starts at 1.5, Kenya's rate for paid overtime on a working day, so time off is worth no less than pay would be. Change it to your own policy.
fields.label: After-Hours Rate

fields.description: Each hour on a rest day counts as this many hours of time off. Starts at 2, Kenya's rate for paid overtime on a rest day. Change it to your own policy.
fields.label: Rest Day Rate

fields.description: Each hour on a public holiday counts as this many hours of time off. Starts at 2, Kenya's rate for paid overtime on a public holiday. Change it to your own policy.
fields.label: Public Holiday Rate

fields.description: The shortest extra time that counts on a day. Shorter extra time on a day is not counted.
fields.label: Daily Minimum (Hours)

fields.description: The most extra hours that count on one day. 0 means no limit.
fields.label: Daily Limit (Hours)

fields.description: How long the time off can be used. Unused time off lapses this many days after it was earned.
fields.label: Validity (Days)

fields.description: The day the validity is counted from.
fields.label: Validity Start
fields.options:
The last day worked
The day the claim is approved

fields.description: Claims must be sent within this many days of the work. 0 means any time.
fields.label: Claim Deadline (Days)

fields.description: The most time off a person can hold. Starts at 10 days, so time off is taken rather than saved up. 0 means no limit. A claim that goes over adds what fits and shows the rest as not added.
fields.label: Balance Limit (Days)

fields.description: What approvers see beside each claim, and what staff can fill a claim from.
fields.label: Evidence

fields.description: Show approvers the hours attendance and the clock-in reader record, and let staff fill a claim from them.
fields.label: Attendance and Clock-ins

fields.description: Show approvers the hours on the person's submitted timesheets, and let staff fill a claim from them.
fields.label: Timesheets

fields.description: Tell HR when a claim waits longer than this many days. App Health lists claims waiting for a decision longer than this. 0 turns it off.
fields.label: Overdue Claim Alert (Days)

fields.description: Staff send their timesheets to their approver, who approves or returns them. Staff can no longer submit their own.
fields.label: Requires Approval

fields.description: Who approves timesheets. Line manager is the person's "Reports To"; where they have no login, the leave approver approves instead.
fields.label: Approver

fields.description: Tell HR when a timesheet waits longer than this many days. App Health lists timesheets waiting for approval longer than this. 0 turns it off.
fields.label: Overdue Timesheet Alert (Days)

fields.description: One timesheet per person per week, filled in as a week. Staff enter hours in a grid, a line per piece of work and a column per day; the form shows their leave, holidays and attendance.
fields.label: Weekly Timesheets

fields.description: The kind of work a new line starts with.
fields.label: Default Activity Type

fields.description: Each day's hours are recorded from this time, one piece of work after another.
fields.label: Day Start Time

fields.description: What happens when a week does not account for the person's time. A week accounts for the time when each working day's hours plus approved leave make a full day. Refusing also stops hours on a full day of leave.
fields.label: Unaccounted Time
fields.options:
Point out gaps
Refuse to send a week that is not accounted for

name: Working Time Policy
